rows.section: Case card "AI Startup, Toronto (SR&ED + HST Refunds)"
rows.before:
AI Startup, Toronto (SR&ED + HST Refunds)<\/h3>

An AI startup with 4 developers, $520,000 in eligible developer salaries and $180,000 in Canadian operating expenses (100% US revenue) was not claiming SR&ED or HST refunds. We filed the SR&ED claim ($105,000 refundable on first $300,000 + $33,000 non-refundable on the remaining $220,000), registered for monthly HST filing ($23,400\/year in ITC refunds from zero-rated US revenue), and set up salary-dividend splits for 2 co-founders. Combined annual benefit: $161,400.<\/p>

$105,000 SR&ED cash + $23,400\/year HST refunds + $33,000 non-refundable credits<\/div><\/div>\r\n
